purpose: Repeat the stopped three-cell protocol gate with Core-v3, whose only semantic change from Core-v2 is an explicit direct-assistant marker-channel rule, then conditionally measure Legacy Quant-H0 versus Core-v3 through newly scheduled matched executions on the unchanged 12-task, six-domain, outcome-blind-selected but historically public and exposed QFBench development panel. This is Worker-substrate construct calibration and breadth mapping, not QRS evolution, candidate improvement, sealed evaluation, or benchmark-wide superiority.

cells.observed_marker_channel: All 12 S1-S6 events were emitted as direct assistant-role standalone text and the trusted parser marked the protocol complete.
The Worker placed every QSTATE marker inside run_shell_command echo calls; the strings appeared only in ToolUse/tool stdout, so the trusted assistant-role parser correctly recorded zero events.
The Worker returned model_empty_response_before_worker_progress with zero turns, tool calls, and artifacts; this is infrastructure/model-sample invalidity, not evidence about marker realization.

measured_antecedent.causal_scope: R1 isolates one observed marker-channel failure on holdings. Swap shows Core-v2 can realize the direct channel; FX contributes no protocol evidence. R1 scores and traces do not select or modify any breadth task.
measured_antecedent.score_use: Official outcomes are retained controller-side evidence only. They cannot authorize R2 breadth and are not Worker-visible.

allowed: require every QSTATE marker to be direct assistant-role plain text on its own line
state that markers inside ToolUse, run_shell_command, echo or printf commands, tool descriptions, tool stdout or stderr, or any other tool call/result do not count
forbid final-only retrospective backfill and require each marker at the transition it records
forbidden: new quantitative method, formula, estimator, data-cleaning heuristic, artifact checklist, task identifier, hidden property, expected value, or benchmark-specific convention
stage definition, marker grammar, model, provider, shell descriptor, tool binding, budget, runtime, verifier, selector, task, metric, or terminal-threshold changes
core_v3_change_boundary.scientific_role: Core-v3 repairs only the live-observed marker-output-channel failure. It remains the same thin human-authored six-state interface rather than a detailed quant workflow.

selection_rule.domain_rule: Use each of the six manifest domains. Within each domain, choose one low task from difficulty easy or medium and one high task from difficulty hard, medium-hard, very-hard, or very_hard.
selection_rule.draw_rule: Sort task IDs within each domain and stratum, then choose one with Python random.Random('20260824:' + domain + ':' + stratum).choice. The selector may read only task_id, domain, difficulty, reward_kind, and resource_source from the manifest.
selection_rule.eligibility_rationale: Binary-only keeps the native task-level reward and paired win-tie-loss estimand uniform. Upstream-only avoids making QEA-authored fallback resource contracts an additional treatment in the Worker-substrate comparison. The domain and difficulty fields are repository-maintained public-contract taxonomy, not claimed as an official randomized QFBench sampling frame.
selection_rule.forbidden_selection_inputs: Prior reward, official passed count, failed-property identity, verifier output, Worker trace, candidate history, artifact contents, or researcher preference after seeing an outcome.
selection_rule.historical_exposure_boundary: The task identities and public contracts are historically public/exposed and may have appeared in earlier repository development or train-validation-test bookkeeping. Only these executions are new. The panel is selection-outcome-blind, not unseen, sealed, or contamination-free.
selection_rule.estimand: Equal-domain descriptive development breadth over this preregistered 12-task sample from the 57-task eligible development universe, not an unbiased estimate of all 77 primary QFBench tasks.

answer_boundary: Every Worker sees only the public task instruction and data, its frozen Worker harness, and the shared trusted runtime rule. No prior score, failed-property identity, verifier result, expected value, diagnostic, Reviewer result, Evolver instruction, or candidate history is Worker-visible.

deploy_source_freeze.resolution: Deploy the future commit that first contains this separately frozen R2 plan, Core-v3, its focused tests, the trusted state-trace parser, and the then-current runner. Record the exact revision in operational evidence without editing this plan.

protocol_gate.proceed_only_if: All three Worker/verifier observations are valid and all three research-state traces account for S1 through S6 in order with no malformed marker, sequence issue, or non-assistant marker channel. Official score is recorded but cannot authorize the breadth phase.
protocol_gate.failure_action: Stop without launching a breadth unit. Retain the result and revise only marker realization in a separately frozen version.

execution.preflight: Before any model call, verify the exact source revision, the two effective Worker directories (Legacy Quant-H0 and Core-v3; seed and Legacy arm may reference the same directory), byte-identical shell descriptors, the unchanged 12 selected task identities in the pinned manifest, task image/resource availability, clean exact run namespaces, and sufficient disk/memory.
execution.phase_order: Run the protocol gate first. If and only if it passes, run both repetition-1 breadth groups. Audit all 24 matched breadth cells before any repetition-2 launch.
execution.repetition_2: Repetition 2 is frozen but not automatic. It reverses arm order within each group and may run only after repetition 1 is valid, protocol-complete, and within budget. Repetition-1 scores cannot change tasks, Workers, grouping, or budgets.
execution.hard_wall: Protocol gate RuntimeMaxSec=7200. Each six-task breadth unit RuntimeMaxSec=28800.
execution.resume: Resume only the same exact run ID and checkpoint. Do not replace a task or route after observing an outcome.

metrics.primary: Per task and repetition: valid official binary reward and complete passed/total vector. The win-tie-loss unit is each of the 24 matched task-repetition pairs. For each task, average its two repetition-level rewards; within each domain, average its two task means; the headline domain macro is the unweighted mean of the six domain means. Report every underlying paired value.
metrics.secondary: For each matched cell with Legacy not full, headroom_closure=(Core_passed-Legacy_passed)/(total-Legacy_passed), without clipping; report N/A when Legacy is full. Also report passed-property fraction, the count of tasks on which Core is full in both repetitions, the sum of total-Core_passed across all 24 Core cells, and task-level discordance across repetitions. Do not pool raw properties across tasks as the headline.
metrics.construct: Core-v3 S1-S6 marker completeness, first-entry order, malformed markers, explicit revisits, execution validity, artifact count, turns, tool calls/errors, requests, tokens, cost, and wall time.
metrics.overhead_acceptance: Across both repetitions, every Core-v3 cell must be selection-valid and each of aggregate Core-v3 provider cost, total tokens, and Worker wall time must be no more than 1.50 times the corresponding Legacy aggregate. This descriptive threshold is an engineering retention gate, not a significance test.
metrics.interpretation: Marker completeness is observability, not quantitative correctness. A 12-task panel is a disclosed stratified development breadth map, not a representative estimate of all QFBench tasks. Two repetitions support descriptive paired discordance and order reversal only, not stability, significance, or broad superiority.

terminal_decisions.when: Any protocol-gate Core-v3 trace is incomplete or malformed.
All three protocol-gate cells are valid and marker-complete.
Any breadth cell is infrastructure-invalid, the matched treatment differs outside Core-v3, or accounting cannot be reconciled.
All 24 repetition-1 cells are valid and all 12 Core-v3 traces are marker-complete.
terminal_decisions.next_dispatch: separately launch the frozen reverse-order repetition 2 only after audit

terminal_decisions.when: Across both repetitions Core-v3 is full-score in both repetitions on at least 10 of 12 tasks, the sum of total-Core_passed across the 24 Core cells is below six, all 48 breadth cells are selection-valid, and the 1.50x cost/token/wall overhead thresholds pass.
terminal_decisions.interpretation: Disclose the strong human scaffold and select a harder public development panel by a separately frozen outcome-blind rule; do not weaken Core-v3 to create artificial QRS headroom.

terminal_decisions.when: Protocol is realized, all 48 breadth cells are selection-valid, the 1.50x cost/token/wall overhead thresholds pass, at least six of 12 tasks have a non-full Core-v3 result in at least one repetition, and at least four of six domains contain one such task.
terminal_decisions.interpretation: Freeze Core-v3 as the prospective QRS starting substrate and use only disclosed development tasks with headroom for adaptive search; keep a separate never-feedback sealed panel.

claim_boundary: This R2 plan tests whether a direct-assistant-channel repair makes the otherwise unchanged protocol-only thin state scaffold executable and, only after that gate, how the scaffold changes a matched Worker across the unchanged 12-task public-metadata-stratified development panel. It does not test QRS, Evolver, Candidate Reviewer, stable harness promotion, AHE, sealed generalization, or QFBench-wide superiority. Deliberate task selection and all exact task IDs must be disclosed in the paper or appendix.
